== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. The first Alternate Image (19 February 2021) printed the pre-2019 wording “any starship”; the re-made image of 15 January 2022 printed the errata wording and the mark E1. [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Remastered)]] (Players Committee logo added; same words and mark) shares the PC Errata column. The regular-image printings have their own table, [[Template:Card errata/Green Leader In Green Squadron 1]]. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
